title: General requirements.
officialText: Concrete materials, design, construction, quality, inspection and testing shall meet the requirements of reference standard RS 10-3. Precast concrete construction utilizing a thin skin or slab stiffened or supported by a system of ribs shall conform to the requirements of reference standard RS 10-4.
